statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); pdir=$(dirname "$cwd"); if [ "$pdir" != "/" ] && [ "$pdir" != "$HOME" ]; then dir="$(basename "$pdir")/$dir"; fi; git_info=""; if cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); st=""; git --no-optional-locks diff --quiet 2>/dev/null && git --no-optional-locks diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null || st="*"; git_info=" $branch$st"; fi; lang=""; [ -f "$cwd/build.gradle.kts" ] || [ -f "$cwd/build.gradle" ] && lang=" "; [ -f "$cwd/package.json" ] && lang=" "; time=$(date +%H:%M); ctxinfo=""; [ -n "$ctx" ] && ctxinfo=" $(printf %.0f $ctx)%"; printf "\033[48;5;210;38;5;235m 󰀵 \033[0m\033[48;5;216;38;5;235m  %s \033[0m" "$dir"; [ -n "$git_info" ] && printf "\033[48;5;222;38;5;235m%s \033[0m" "$git_info"; [ -n "$lang" ] && printf "\033[48;5;150;38;5;235m%s\033[0m" "$lang"; printf "\033[48;5;183;38;5;235m  %s \033[0m" "$time"; [ -n "$ctxinfo" ] && printf " \033[38;5;183m%s\033[0m" "$ctxinfo"; echo
